summary: Abits Group Inc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its notice of annual meeting and proxy statement for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, with the virtual AGM set for December 15, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern. Record date is November 12, 2026, with 3,554,439 ordinary shares outstanding; mailing begins on or about November 14, 2026. Agenda items are election of five directors, ratification of Audit Alliance LLP as auditor for FY2026, and approval of the 2026 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan. This is a routine meeting notice and proxy circular, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or price references are stated.
